turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What's your take on the invoicing and billing experience overall?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Invoices are clear and itemized, that part's fine. What's annoying is that our account has two different billing contacts and only one of them receives the invoice emails — support couldn't help us add a second recipient.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Did that cause a real problem?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We missed a payment once because of it and got a service pause warning, which was stressful for something that should be a simple settings fix.
